description: This file contains multiple PHP classes related to YouTrack API interaction, including data type representations (Issue, Comment, User, etc.), exceptions, and utility classes.

classes.name: NotImplementedException
classes.description: Exception class thrown when a function is not yet implemented.

classes.name: YouTrackException
classes.description: Custom exception for YouTrack API errors, including HTTP errors and error messages.

classes.name: YouTrackObject
classes.description: Base class representing a generic YouTrack-related data object with dynamic attribute handling.

classes.name: YouTrackError
classes.description: Represents an error response from YouTrack, extends YouTrackObject.

classes.name: Issue
classes.description: Represents a YouTrack issue, with methods for accessing related data such as comments, attachments, links, reporter, and assignee.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment on a YouTrack issue, with a method to get author info.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Represents a link between YouTrack issues.

classes.name: Attachment
classes.description: Represents an attachment in YouTrack, with method to get attachment content.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a YouTrack project with methods to get subsystems and create new subsystems.

classes.name: Subsystem
classes.description: Represents a subsystem within a project.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a version in YouTrack, initializes description and release date if empty.

classes.name: IssueLinkType
classes.description: Represents a link type between issues.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Represents a custom field for issues.

classes.name: ProjectCustomField
classes.description: Represents a custom field specific to projects, with unimplemented children attribute update.

classes.name: EnumBundle
classes.description: Represents an enumeration bundle with a name and list of values, can output its XML representation.
